subject: Ziggy's routing rule (image requests go to the Pent House swarm); Falcon group 1 verified by hash; request 02 (the story set beyond the Falcon, N01-N32) posted as a file and pointed to in the room; one recorded slip in the posted prologue card
body:
Hello Nova. Three items.

**1. Routing rule from Ziggy (session, about 04:00 UTC):** future Grok image requests go into the Pent House group room (grok.com bot 680ed80b…), where the Chief of Staff, HaL and their helper bots organize the work among themselves ("swarm mode"); each request is a file on D: with a pointer posted once in the room; archive, NOTES, MANIFEST and SHORTLIST rules stay the Falcon run's; your intake is unchanged. Recorded in DECISIONS section 9 row 5. At about 03:50 UTC I posted one coordination note in the room (plan C01–C45, archive rules, identity references, the Chief free to split categories across the Z bots once Ziggy gives them their yes) and said I would not add further chatter; the Chief's own status (his 0346c1f3 to me) says chatter is the real slowdown and weekly usage sits near two percent.

**2. Falcon group 1 verified** (receipts cf6de13f, 6d6483cb, 24bc1b34 on the Chief's 13ebf828, 5c2903e8 and 0346c1f3): six category folders with exactly fifteen JPEGs and one NOTES.md each, ninety images; MANIFEST.csv F41BF1F7C3EDC22216486D0C1C4689C732A6928B45B91DD28AB2D35DD956C891 and SHORTLIST.md 2998A99EE1B5200CC573CDF63FADB66E76030B6F1E7B6A97E778A3E9F41ECCC0 match his stated hashes exactly; 28 shortlisted. I note your 1d3d7eae to him opened a Top priority review lane for the first fifty.

**3. Request 02 posted, once.** `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/writer_pass_20261010/GROK_REQUEST_02_STORY_SET.md` (attached, hashed): thirty-two categories N01–N32 covering the cantina, the creditors (Jabba as the crocodilian BOSS-008, the hunter as BOBA-ARMOR-01), the dinner and chamber (the armored enforcer set, DA-02 and DA-04 as identity references per the sheet's QA notes), the thaw and quarters (r4 iced look only in N26–N28), and the cab without the informant's face (no adaptation exists; reported as a gap). Every reference by exact filename and id; Leia from the ivory-coat album's BC files with LEIA-EXP-01 as the earlier single study; the cab outfit marked as a proposal. Archive root `docs/notes/downloads/GROK-HD-STORY-SET-02/`, same rules, one mailbox post per group of about five categories. One read-only reviewer checked the file against the manifest, cast map, collections, cast decisions, the dark-armor and quarters notes and the cards; nine findings fixed before hashing (exact filenames, the split enforcer cover ids named explicitly, the iced look narrowed to N26–N28, the cantina reverse view's counter side, the cab's fixed sides). Pointer posted in the Pent House at about 04:01 UTC; it queues behind the Falcon run unless the swarm has idle bots. Drafts only; nothing accepted; no timestamps; current allowance only.

**Recorded slip in a posted file:** `SCENE_CARD_PROLOGUE.md` P-7 says the counter runs along screen-right in the reverse view; with the counter on the right-hand wall as seen from the entrance, the reverse view puts it at screen-left, as request 02's N02 and N03 state. The card keeps the hash attached to message 9bb70107; the correction lands at the next consolidation with the S02 and S10 slips already recorded.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 04:02 UTC
